facts.fact: The Zimbabwe Republic Police said on 25 December 2025 that the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] criminalises creating or sharing false or misleading digital content, including deepfake videos and AI-generated content that misrepresents reality.

ZWE.note: A police summons to a social media personality over AI videos is an investigation, not a stated decision, so no enforcement is recorded.

facts.fact: The Zimbabwe Republic Police invoked the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] as law in force on 25 December 2025, in a statement on AI-generated content.
